findings.title: Resume-output check can be satisfied by output produced before pause
findings.evidence: The buffer snapshot is taken at line 83, before two seeks and two 25 ms waits. The buffers.load() > before assertion at line 91 can already be true when pause()/play() run. It proves output since the pre-seek snapshot, not necessarily fresh output after that iteration resumes.
findings.impact: No production regression: PR19 is characterization-only, next-iteration startup and final EOS recovery still test real progress. docs/upstream/261/README.md:23 states a stronger per-iteration resume guarantee than this assertion establishes.
findings.recommendation: Optional narrow follow-up: snapshot the counter after pause and immediately before play, or soften the per-iteration claim. No feature-test expansion required.
findings.verification: Confirmed by static ordering of the counter snapshot, waits and assertion; no mutation or extra compile performed.
